positioning: An AI institute for suicide prevention research, policy, practice, and community support.

inspiration.virtual_biotech: Organize specialist AI agents like a research institution with a coordinating executive layer.
inspiration.paper2agent: Compile papers into callable tools/resources/prompts rather than treating each paper only as static text.

divisions.name: Surveillance & Epidemiology Unit
divisions.mission: Trends, risk factors, population patterns and surveillance evidence.

divisions.name: Intervention & Evaluation Unit
divisions.mission: Intervention evidence, programme evaluation and implementation science.

divisions.name: Policy & Implementation Unit
divisions.mission: Policy analysis, evidence-to-action translation and resource-allocation reasoning.

divisions.name: Practitioner & Community Support Unit
divisions.mission: Practice-facing evidence, community resources and human-centred implementation.

divisions.name: Methods & Evidence Unit
divisions.mission: Study design, synthesis, causal inference, provenance and methodological quality.

services.name: Community / Individual Support
services.boundary: Bounded evidence information with human escalation; no autonomous risk scoring.

experimental_organizational_designs.label: Functional Virtual Institute
experimental_organizational_designs.description: Functionally differentiated agents coordinated by a facilitator in a shared evidence context.

experimental_organizational_designs.label: Paper-Agent Committee
experimental_organizational_designs.description: Paper-level agents deliberate under a committee chair/orchestrator.

experimental_organizational_designs.label: Shared-Knowledge Umbrella
experimental_organizational_designs.description: A small institutional reasoning layer uses shared Paper Skills and an Evidence Graph.

research_question: How does organizational design shape collective reasoning, evidence integration and decision quality in AI co-scientists?
non_claims: This scaffold does not establish that any architecture is superior.
This scaffold is not a clinical decision-support system.
Community-facing use requires bounded outputs, human oversight and additional validation.
